note: Los Padres NF campground in oak woodland beside Paradise Road in the Santa Ynez valley, run by the concessionaire Camp Los Padres. The Santa Ynez River is reached through a tunnel under Paradise Road; White Rock day-use area is under half a mile away. Sites 11 and 13 take 24 ft at most. The nearest dump station is at Cachuma Lake County Park, about 11 miles. --Claude
summary: rec.gov API + catalog + availability + FS page read. 14 sites (was ~15), all reservable, RV to 40 ft (12 of 14 36 ft+); no hookups, flush toilets + water, no dump (11 mi); $40 -> $42 (rec.gov 2026-2028), double $82; year-round (was unknown); weekend 2 / holiday 3 minimums, max 14. Open, only fire-use restrictions. Not waterfront confirmed (river across Paradise Road via a tunnel). Pin OK (~85 m from centroid).
flags: FEES: stored $40 -> $42 (rec.gov rate tables 2026, 2027, 2028: $42 single, $82 double). The FS page says '$40.00 per site, per night. Additional $2.00 weekend and holiday fees' - rec.gov written, FS figure in fees.note.

BOOKING: FS says '12 campsites are on the reservation system and (2 sites) are first-come'; rec.gov now lists all 14 as reservable - rec.gov used, fcfs left unset.

PHONE: 805-434-1996 (rec.gov facility_phone) -> 820-500-1099 (rec.gov notice: 'Camp Los Padres manages this campground ... call 820-500-1099'; the facility description also says '(820) 500-1099'). Santa Barbara Ranger District: 805-724-0079 or 805-967-3481.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept - the river is across Paradise Road, reached through a tunnel (rec.gov). Pin 34.54298,-119.81167 is ~85 m from the site centroid 34.54223,-119.81195 - kept.
OHV: rec.gov mentions the Camuesa OHV Route within 10 miles - general campground, not an OHV camp.
